queries.name: agent/resolve_places
queries.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Place', $term) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS id, labels(node) AS labels, node.name AS name, node.country AS country, score
ORDER BY score DESC, id
LIMIT 5

queries.name: agent/ids_exist
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS id
OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: id})
RETURN id, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n) END AS labels
ORDER BY id

queries.name: incident/resolve_places
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS id
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Place {id: id})
RETURN id, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n) END AS labels
ORDER BY id

queries.name: incident/zone_sites
queries.cypher:
MATCH (z:HazardZone {id: $zone_id})<-[iz:IN_ZONE]-(r:Region)<-[li:LOCATED_IN]-(s:Site)
RETURN r.id AS region, collect(s.id) AS sites
ORDER BY region

queries.name: incident/open_covering
queries.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'})-[a:AFFECTS]->(s:Site)
WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
RETURN i.id AS incident, i.title AS title, i.expected_end_day AS end_day, collect(s.id) AS sites
ORDER BY incident

queries.name: agent/next_incident_id
queries.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident)
RETURN count(i) AS n

queries.name: incident/declare
queries.cypher:
MATCH (m:Meta {id: 'META'})
SET m.world_version = m.world_version + 1
CREATE (inc:Incident {id: $incident_id, kind: $kind, title: $title, alert_text: $alert,
                      started_day: $day, expected_end_day: $end_day, severity: $factor, status: 'open'})
WITH inc, m
MATCH (s:Site) WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
SET s.status = 'disrupted', s.capacity_factor = $factor, s.disrupted_until = $end_day
CREATE (inc)-[a:AFFECTS {factor: $factor}]->(s)
RETURN inc.id AS incident, count(a) AS sites_affected, m.world_version AS world_version

queries.name: agent/ids_exist
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS id
OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: id})
RETURN id, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n) END AS labels
ORDER BY id

queries.name: exposure/tier1_view
queries.cypher:
MATCH (inc:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[a:AFFECTS]->(s:Site)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(pl:Plant)
RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS directly_affected_tier1, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS sites

queries.name: exposure/exposure
queries.cypher:
MATCH (inc:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[a:AFFECTS]->(d:Site)
MATCH chain = (d)-[:FEEDS*0..4]->(t1:Site)
MATCH (t1)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(pl:Plant)-[b:BUILDS]->(prod:Product)-[req:REQUIRES]->(k:Component)
WHERE k.id = sup.component_id
MATCH (o:Order)-[fp:FOR_PRODUCT]->(prod)
MATCH (o)-[fa:FULFILLED_AT]->(pl)
WHERE o.status = 'open' AND o.need_day <= $horizon
RETURN d.id AS origin, [n IN nodes(chain) | n.id] AS supply_path, length(chain) AS upstream_hops,
       t1.id AS tier1, k.id AS component, prod.id AS product, pl.id AS plant,
       collect(o.id) AS orders, sum(o.value_cents) AS value_cents
ORDER BY origin, tier1, plant, component, product, upstream_hops

queries.name: exposure/shared_upstream
queries.cypher:
MATCH (inc:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[a:AFFECTS]->(d:Site)
MATCH (d)-[f:FEEDS*1..4]->(t1:Site)-[e:SUPPLIES|CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant)
WITH d, collect(DISTINCT t1.id) AS dependents
WHERE size(dependents) >= 2
MATCH (sup:Supplier)-[op:OPERATES]->(d)
RETURN d.id AS shared_upstream, sup.name AS operator, dependents, size(dependents) AS fan_out
ORDER BY shared_upstream

queries.name: memory/recall
queries.cypher:
MATCH (n:Entity) WHERE n.id IN $entity_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc:Incident)-[inv:INVOLVED]->(n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (l:Lesson)-[ab:ABOUT]->(n)
RETURN n.id AS entity, n.name AS name, n.reliability AS reliability,
       collect(DISTINCT {id: inc.id, title: inc.title, learned_on: inc.learned_on}) AS incidents,
       collect(DISTINCT {text: l.text, learned_on: l.learned_on, incident_id: l.incident_id}) AS lessons
ORDER BY entity

queries.name: shortage/supply_edges
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Site)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(pl:Plant)
RETURN s.id AS site, pl.id AS plant, sup.component_id AS component, sup.used_wk AS used_wk,
       sup.transit_days AS transit_days
ORDER BY site, plant, component

queries.name: shortage/upstream_feeds
queries.cypher:
MATCH (t1:Site)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(:Plant)
MATCH p = (:Site)-[:FEEDS*1..4]->(t1)
UNWIND relationships(p) AS f
WITH DISTINCT f
RETURN startNode(f).id AS src, endNode(f).id AS dst, f.component_id AS component,
       f.used_wk AS used_wk, f.cap_wk AS cap_wk
ORDER BY src, dst, component

queries.name: shortage/sites
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Site) WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
RETURN s.id AS site, s.capacity_factor AS factor, s.status AS status,
       s.disrupted_until AS disrupted_until, s.input_buffer_days AS input_buffer_days
ORDER BY site

queries.name: upstream/purchase_orders
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[fs:FROM_SITE]->(s:Site)
MATCH (po)-[fc:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k:Component)
MATCH (po)-[dt:DELIVERS_TO]->(pl:Plant)
WHERE po.status IN ['committed', 'in_transit']
RETURN po.id AS po_id, s.id AS site, k.id AS component, pl.id AS plant, po.rate_wk AS rate_wk, po.qty AS qty,
       po.first_arrival_day AS first_arrival_day, po.unit_price_cents AS unit_price_cents
ORDER BY po_id

queries.name: shortage/stock
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pl:Plant)-[st:STOCKS]->(k:Component)
RETURN pl.id AS plant, k.id AS component, st.on_hand AS on_hand
ORDER BY plant, component

queries.name: shortage/orders
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[pc:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[fp:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p:Product)-[req:REQUIRES]->(k:Component)
MATCH (o)-[fa:FULFILLED_AT]->(pl:Plant)
WHERE o.status IN ['open', 'protected_projected'] AND o.need_day <= $horizon
RETURN o.id AS order_id, pl.id AS plant, p.id AS product, o.need_day AS need_day, o.qty AS qty,
       k.id AS component, o.qty * req.qty AS units, c.id AS customer, c.tier AS tier,
       c.penalty_per_day_cents AS penalty_cents, o.value_cents AS value_cents
ORDER BY need_day, order_id, component

OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: id})
RETURN id, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n) END AS labels
ORDER BY id

queries.name: alternatives/acceptable
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pl:Plant {id: $plant_id})-[b:BUILDS]->(p:Product)-[req:REQUIRES]->(k:Component {id: $component_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[aa:ALLOWS_ALTERNATE]->(alt:Component)
WHERE aa.for_component = $component_id
RETURN p.id AS product, collect(DISTINCT alt.id) AS alternates
ORDER BY product

queries.name: alternatives/lookalikes
queries.cypher:
MATCH (k:Component {id: $component_id})-[m1:MADE_FROM]->(x:Component)<-[m2:MADE_FROM]-(c:Component)
WHERE c.id <> k.id AND c.family = k.family
RETURN DISTINCT c.id AS component
ORDER BY component

queries.name: alternatives/candidates
queries.cypher:
MATCH (alt:Site)-[cs:CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant {id: $plant_id})
WHERE cs.component_id IN $component_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH taint = (bad:Site)-[:FEEDS*1..4]->(alt)
WHERE bad.status = 'disrupted'
WITH alt, cs, collect(DISTINCT [n IN nodes(taint) | n.id]) AS tainted_paths
RETURN alt.id AS site, cs.component_id AS component, cs.spare_wk AS spare_wk, coalesce(cs.reserved_wk, 0) AS reserved_wk,
       cs.unit_price_cents AS price_cents, cs.lead_days AS lead_days, cs.transit_days AS transit_days,
       cs.air_transit_days AS air_transit_days, cs.air_surcharge_cents AS air_surcharge_cents,
       cs.moq AS moq, cs.qualified AS qualified, cs.requal_days AS requal_days,
       alt.status AS site_status, tainted_paths
ORDER BY price_cents, site

queries.name: flow/supply_edges
queries.cypher:
MATCH (t1:Site)-[e:SUPPLIES|CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant {id: $plant_id})
WHERE e.component_id = $component_id
RETURN t1.id AS site, type(e) AS kind, coalesce(e.used_wk, 0) AS used_wk, coalesce(e.spare_wk, 0) AS spare_wk,
       t1.capacity_wk AS site_cap, t1.capacity_factor AS factor, t1.status AS status
ORDER BY site, kind

queries.name: flow/upstream_feeds
queries.cypher:
MATCH (t1:Site)-[e:SUPPLIES|CAN_SUPPLY]->(:Plant {id: $plant_id})
WHERE e.component_id = $component_id
MATCH p = (:Site)-[:FEEDS*1..4]->(t1)
UNWIND relationships(p) AS f
WITH DISTINCT f
RETURN startNode(f).id AS src, endNode(f).id AS dst, f.component_id AS component, f.cap_wk AS cap_wk,
       f.used_wk AS used_wk, startNode(f).capacity_wk AS src_cap, startNode(f).capacity_factor AS src_factor
ORDER BY src, dst, component

queries.name: flow/bom_ratios
queries.cypher:
MATCH p = (k:Component {id: $component_id})-[:MADE_FROM*1..4]->(c:Component)
RETURN c.id AS component, [r IN relationships(p) | r.qty] AS qtys
ORDER BY component

queries.name: flow/load_nodes
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS r
CREATE (n:F {id: r.id})
RETURN count(n) AS created

queries.name: flow/load_edges
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS r
MATCH (a:F {id: r.src})
MATCH (b:F {id: r.dst})
CREATE (a)-[e:CAP {cap: r.cap, cap_nominal: r.cap_nominal}]->(b)
RETURN count(e) AS created

queries.name: flow/maxflow
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:F) WHERE s.id IN $source_ids
WITH collect(s) AS sources
MATCH (t:F {id: $sink_id})
CALL algo.maxFlow({sourceNodes: sources, targetNodes: [t], capacityProperty: $capacity_property,
                   relationshipTypes: ['CAP']})
YIELD edges, edgeFlows, maxFlow
UNWIND range(0, size(edges) - 1) AS i
RETURN startNode(edges[i]).id AS src, endNode(edges[i]).id AS dst, edgeFlows[i] AS flow, maxFlow AS max_flow

queries.name: execute/preflight
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $pos AS po
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Site {id: po.site_id})-[cs:CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant {id: po.plant_id})
WHERE cs.component_id = po.component_id
OPTIONAL MATCH (k:Component {id: po.component_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (existing:PurchaseOrder {id: po.id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.id IN po.order_ids
RETURN po.id AS po_id, count(DISTINCT cs) AS edges, count(DISTINCT k) AS components,
       count(DISTINCT existing) AS existing, count(DISTINCT o) AS orders_found, size(po.order_ids) AS orders_planned,
       size(po.allocations) AS allocations, max(cs.spare_wk - coalesce(cs.reserved_wk, 0)) AS free_wk, po.rate_wk AS rate_wk
ORDER BY po_id

queries.name: execute/write
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
WHERE d.status = 'approved' AND d.plan_hash = $plan_hash
MATCH (m:Meta {id: 'META'})
WHERE m.world_version = $world_version
SET m.world_version = m.world_version + 1
WITH d, m
UNWIND $pos AS po
MATCH (s:Site {id: po.site_id})-[cs:CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant {id: po.plant_id})
WHERE cs.component_id = po.component_id
MATCH (k:Component {id: po.component_id})
CREATE (p:PurchaseOrder {id: po.id, qty: po.qty, rate_wk: po.rate_wk, unit_price_cents: po.unit_price_cents,
                         mode: po.mode, first_arrival_day: po.first_arrival_day, status: 'committed',
                         created_by: 'domino'})
CREATE (d)-[:CREATED]->(p), (p)-[:FROM_SITE]->(s), (p)-[:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k), (p)-[:DELIVERS_TO]->(pl)
SET cs.reserved_wk = coalesce(cs.reserved_wk, 0) + po.rate_wk
WITH d, m, p, po
UNWIND po.allocations AS a
MATCH (o:Order {id: a.order_id})
CREATE (p)-[pr:PROTECTS {qty: a.qty, arrival_day: a.arrival_day}]->(o)
SET o.status = 'protected_projected'
WITH d, m, count(DISTINCT p) AS pos_created, count(pr) AS protects_created, collect(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
SET d.status = 'executed', d.executed_day = $day
CREATE (d)-[:LOGGED]->(act:Action {id: $action_id, type: 'execute', actor: 'executor', day: $day,
                                    payload_json: $payload_json})
RETURN d.id AS decision, pos_created, protects_created, orders, m.world_version AS world_version

ORDER BY po_id, need_day, order_id

queries.name: verify/v1_spare
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[fs:FROM_SITE]->(s:Site)-[cs:CAN_SUPPLY]->(pl:Plant)
MATCH (po)-[dt:DELIVERS_TO]->(pl)
MATCH (po)-[fc:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k:Component)
WHERE k.id = cs.component_id AND po.status IN ['committed', 'in_transit']
WITH s, pl, cs, sum(po.rate_wk) AS committed
WHERE committed > cs.spare_wk
RETURN s.id AS site, pl.id AS plant, cs.component_id AS component, committed, cs.spare_wk AS spare
ORDER BY site, plant

queries.name: verify/v2_bom
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[pr:PROTECTS]->(o:Order)-[fp:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p:Product)
MATCH (po)-[fc:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k:Component)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:REQUIRES|ALLOWS_ALTERNATE]->(k)
WITH po, o, p, k, count(r) AS approved
WHERE approved = 0
RETURN po.id AS po, o.id AS order_id, p.id AS product, k.id AS component
ORDER BY po, order_id

queries.name: verify/v4_arrival
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[pr:PROTECTS]->(o:Order)
WHERE pr.arrival_day > o.need_day
RETURN po.id AS po, o.id AS order_id, pr.arrival_day AS arrival_day, o.need_day AS need_day
ORDER BY po, order_id

queries.name: verify/v5_budget
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:Decision)-[c:CREATED]->(po:PurchaseOrder)
WITH d, sum(po.qty * po.unit_price_cents) AS spend
WHERE spend > d.budget_cents
RETURN d.id AS decision, spend, d.budget_cents AS budget_cents

queries.name: verify/v6_unique
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:Decision)-[c:CREATED]->(po:PurchaseOrder)-[fs:FROM_SITE]->(s:Site)
MATCH (po)-[fc:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k:Component)
MATCH (po)-[dt:DELIVERS_TO]->(pl:Plant)
WITH d, s, k, pl, count(po) AS n
WHERE n > 1
RETURN d.id AS decision, s.id AS site, k.id AS component, pl.id AS plant, n

queries.name: verify/v7_coverage
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[pr:PROTECTS]->(o:Order {status: 'protected_projected'})-[fp:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p:Product)
MATCH (po)-[fc:FOR_COMPONENT]->(k:Component)
WITH o, p, k, sum(pr.qty) AS covered
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[req:REQUIRES]->(k)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[alt:ALLOWS_ALTERNATE]->(k)
WITH o, k, covered, o.qty * coalesce(req.qty, alt.qty, 0) AS needed
WHERE covered < needed
RETURN o.id AS order_id, k.id AS component, covered, needed
ORDER BY order_id

ORDER BY order_id

queries.name: upstream/site_feeders
queries.cypher:
MATCH (u:Site)-[f:FEEDS]->(s:Site)
WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
RETURN s.id AS site, u.id AS src, f.component_id AS component, f.cap_wk AS cap_wk, f.used_wk AS used_wk
ORDER BY site, src, component

queries.name: upstream/feeder_load
queries.cypher:
MATCH (u:Site) WHERE u.id IN $site_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[f:FEEDS]->(:Site)
RETURN u.id AS site, u.capacity_wk AS capacity_wk, u.capacity_factor AS factor,
       sum(coalesce(f.used_wk, 0)) AS used_out
ORDER BY site

queries.name: upstream/sites
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Site) WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (sup:Supplier)-[op:OPERATES]->(s)
RETURN s.id AS site, s.capacity_factor AS factor, s.status AS status, sup.reliability AS reliability
ORDER BY site

queries.name: upstream/bom_inputs
queries.cypher:
MATCH (k:Component)-[m:MADE_FROM]->(c:Component)
WHERE k.id IN $component_ids
RETURN k.id AS component, c.id AS input, m.qty AS qty
ORDER BY component, input

queries.name: shortage/supply_edges
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Site)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(pl:Plant)
RETURN s.id AS site, pl.id AS plant, sup.component_id AS component, sup.used_wk AS used_wk,
       sup.transit_days AS transit_days
ORDER BY site, plant, component

queries.name: shortage/upstream_feeds
queries.cypher:
MATCH (t1:Site)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(:Plant)
MATCH p = (:Site)-[:FEEDS*1..4]->(t1)
UNWIND relationships(p) AS f
WITH DISTINCT f
RETURN startNode(f).id AS src, endNode(f).id AS dst, f.component_id AS component,
       f.used_wk AS used_wk, f.cap_wk AS cap_wk
ORDER BY src, dst, component

queries.name: shortage/sites
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Site) WHERE s.id IN $site_ids
RETURN s.id AS site, s.capacity_factor AS factor, s.status AS status,
       s.disrupted_until AS disrupted_until, s.input_buffer_days AS input_buffer_days
ORDER BY site

queries.name: upstream/protects
queries.cypher:
MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[pr:PROTECTS]->(o:Order)
WHERE po.status IN ['committed', 'in_transit']
RETURN po.id AS po_id, o.id AS order_id, pr.qty AS qty, o.need_day AS need_day
ORDER BY po_id, need_day, order_id

queries.name: shortage/stock
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pl:Plant)-[st:STOCKS]->(k:Component)
RETURN pl.id AS plant, k.id AS component, st.on_hand AS on_hand
ORDER BY plant, component

queries.name: shortage/orders
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[pc:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[fp:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p:Product)-[req:REQUIRES]->(k:Component)
MATCH (o)-[fa:FULFILLED_AT]->(pl:Plant)
WHERE o.status IN ['open', 'protected_projected'] AND o.need_day <= $horizon
RETURN o.id AS order_id, pl.id AS plant, p.id AS product, o.need_day AS need_day, o.qty AS qty,
       k.id AS component, o.qty * req.qty AS units, c.id AS customer, c.tier AS tier,
       c.penalty_per_day_cents AS penalty_cents, o.value_cents AS value_cents
ORDER BY need_day, order_id, component

queries.name: agent/ids_exist
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS id
OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: id})
RETURN id, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n) END AS labels
ORDER BY id

queries.name: memory/entity_names
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $ids AS id
OPTIONAL MATCH (n {id: id})
RETURN id, n.name AS name, CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN null ELSE labels(n)[0] END AS kind
ORDER BY id

queries.name: memory/write_incident
queries.cypher:
MERGE (inc:Incident {id: $incident.id})
SET inc += $incident
WITH inc
UNWIND $entities AS e
MERGE (n:Entity {id: e.id})
SET n.kind = e.kind, n.name = e.name
MERGE (inc)-[inv:INVOLVED {role: e.role}]->(n)
RETURN count(inv) AS linked

queries.name: memory/write_lessons
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $lessons AS l
MERGE (les:Lesson {id: l.id})
SET les.text = l.text, les.incident_id = l.incident_id, les.learned_on = l.learned_on,
    les.evidence = l.evidence
WITH les, l
UNWIND l.entity_ids AS eid
MERGE (n:Entity {id: eid})
MERGE (les)-[a:ABOUT]->(n)
RETURN count(DISTINCT les) AS lessons, count(a) AS links
